notes.title: Japanese Language Update + DIGITAL EXORCIST World Premiere Demo at BitSummit!
notes.notes:
Now Available in Japanese!
DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0); has just been updated with Japanese language support!

The localization was handled by renowned translator Yosei Mutou, known for work on acclaimed titles such as VA-11 Hall-A and Gone Home.

This update coincides with the news that DIGITAL EXORCIST, the upcoming sequel from COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS, is now officially published by HYPER REAL.

The full game is planned for release in 2026 on Steam.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944390/DIGITAL_EXORCIST/"][/dynamiclink]


DIGITAL EXORCIST Demo at BitSummit the 13th!
The sequel to DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);, DIGITAL EXORCIST, will have its world premiere demo at BitSummit the 13th, held in Kyoto from July 18 to 20, 2025. The demo will be playable in both English and Japanese. Other titles that will be featured at the booth include SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, SKY THE SCRAPER, and Telebbit. Come by the booth, try out our games, and grab some exclusive merch while supplies last! 


Exhibition Overview
Dates: 2025/7/18 (FRI) - 2025/7/20 (SUN) 10:00 - 17:00 

Venue: Kyoto Kangyo-Kan "Miyako Messe", 1F, Exhibition Hall 2

Booth Name: HYPER REAL 

Booth Location: IP2-16



We hope you enjoy the new language support, and we look forward to seeing you at BitSummit!

COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS & HYPER REAL
